<function name="NetworkIDToString" parent="util" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns the networked string associated with the given ID from the string table.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="stringTableID" type="number">ID to get the associated string from.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="string">The networked string, or nil if it wasn't found.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
